ideas.title: Uncovering the Extent of the Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: Investigate the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme and identify other potential perpetrators
ideas.angle: Follow the money and track the flow of funds
questions: What is the extent of the fraud scheme?
ideas.insight: The guilty plea of the Star Distribution Owner and the sentencing of the Rochester Woman suggest a larger fraud scheme at play. Further investigation is needed to uncover the extent of the scheme and identify other potential perpetrators.
